title: 反相放大器：翻个身，再放大
summary: LM358 接 ±9 V 双电源，RIN 10 kΩ、RF 22 kΩ：1 kHz 的正弦被放大、上下翻转；输入太大时，输出被削平。
description: ±9 V 双电源（两台 9 V 电源串联，中点接 GND）。LM358 的 IN+ 接 GND；信号发生器 → RIN（10 kΩ）→ IN−；RF（22 kΩ）从 IN− 接到 OUT。CH1 看输入，CH2 看输出。

cards.title: 搭好，看两条波
text: - **两台 9 V 电源串联**：中间那一点接 GND，上面是 +9 V（接 LM358 的 8 脚），下面是 −9 V（接 4 脚）。这样输出可以是负的。
- **IN+ 接 GND**；信号发生器 → **RIN** → **IN−**；**RF** 从 IN− 接回 OUT。引脚位置和 2.5 一样，用 A 半、B 半都行。
- 信号发生器：正弦、**`1 kHz`**、幅度 **`0.5 V`**。CH1 看输入，CH2 看 OUT。
两条波比一比：CH2 的大小和方向，和 CH1 有什么不同？

cards.title: 虚地：IN− 被钉在 0 V
text: - 接成负反馈的运放会调整输出，让 **IN− 和 IN+ 一样高**。IN+ 接地，所以 IN− 也一直在 0 V，叫**虚地**。
- 输入电流 i = v_in / RIN 流到 IN− 无路可走（运放输入不取电流），只能**全部穿过 RF** 流向 OUT。
![](fig:inv)
- RF 一端在 0 V，所以输出就是 RF 上的电压，方向反过来：
$$v_o = -\frac{R_F}{R_{IN}} v_{in} = -\frac{22 kΩ}{10 kΩ} v_{in}$$
- 负号就是“翻个身”：输入往上走时，输出往下走。
![](fig:wave)

cards.title: 量放大、反相和削顶
text: - 依次试三种输入：① 幅度 **`0.5 V`**；② 再加 **`1 V`** 偏置；③ 幅度改成 **`5 V`**、偏置 **`0 V`**。
- ② 用万用表直流档量 OUT 对 GND：直流也被放大、翻转了吗？
- ③ 按公式输出应该很大，屏幕上却被**削平**了。看看上下各平在哪里。
- 先在测量题里写预测，再读。

cards.title: 带走
text: - **虚地**：IN+ 接地时，IN− 也被拉到 0 V。所以这个放大器的输入电阻就是 RIN。
- **增益 = −RF / RIN**：负号表示反相；直流也一样被放大、翻转。
- **LM358 的输出到不了正电源**：最高只到约 V+ − 1.5 V，最低能到 V−，所以削顶上下不对称。
- **真实电路里**：LM358 的压摆率只有约 0.3–0.5 V/µs。频率升到几十 kHz、幅度又大时，正弦会变成三角波；仿真里没有这个限制。

caption.text: v_in 从上面进来。同一个电流 i 先穿过 RIN、再穿过 RF。IN− 在 0 V（虚地），所以 v_o 就是 RF 上的电压，方向和输入相反。

i18n.en: v_in comes in at the top. The same current i passes RIN, then RF. IN− sits at 0 V (virtual ground), so v_o is the voltage across RF, pointing the other way from the input.

caption.text: 输入往上时输出往下：形状一样，大了 RF / RIN 倍，上下翻转。

i18n.en: When the input goes up the output goes down: same shape, RF / RIN times larger, upside down.

en.title: The inverting amplifier: flip it, then enlarge it
en.summary: An LM358 on ±9 V, RIN 10 kΩ and RF 22 kΩ: a 1 kHz sine comes out larger and upside down; with too much input the output is clipped.
en.description: A ±9 V supply (two 9 V supplies in series, the middle on GND). The LM358's IN+ goes to GND; generator → RIN (10 kΩ) → IN−; RF (22 kΩ) from IN− to OUT. CH1 on the input, CH2 on the output.
hints: Dual supply: two 9 V supplies in series, the middle is GND. The upper one's + goes to op-amp pin 8, the lower one's − to pin 4.
IN+ (pin 3) to GND; generator + → RIN → IN− (pin 2); RF between IN− and OUT (pin 1).
Place two probes (CH1 input, CH2 output), both ground clips on GND.
tests: 1 kHz, 1 Vpp sine: the output is enlarged, average 0 V
With a 1 V offset: DC is enlarged and inverted too, IN− is a virtual ground
10 Vpp input: the output clips top and bottom

measurements.explain: |v_o| = 2.2 × 1 Vpp ≈ 2.2 Vpp. The generator's 50 Ω and the 10 kΩ input resistance divide a little, so the port gives about 0.995 Vpp and you read about 2.19 Vpp.

measurements.ask: Same state: output amplitude / input amplitude (CH2 / CH1, with CH1 on the generator's output)
measurements.explain: On the port voltage |v_o / v_in| = RF / RIN = 2.2. On screen the two waves are exactly upside down to each other (180° apart).

measurements.ask: ② With a 1 V offset: OUT to GND on the multimeter's DC range
measurements.explain: DC is enlarged and inverted too: −2.2 × 0.995 ≈ −2.19 V. IN− stays at 0 V (virtual ground).

measurements.ask: ③ Amplitude 5 V: the output's maximum
measurements.explain: The formula says +11 V, but the output tops out at V+ − 1.5 V ≈ +7.5 V.
The LM358's output reaches all the way to V− = −9 V: lopsided clipping.

cards.title: Build it, watch two waves
text: - **Two 9 V supplies in series**: the point between them is GND, the top is +9 V (to LM358 pin 8), the bottom −9 V (pin 4). Now the output can go negative.
- **IN+ to GND**; generator → **RIN** → **IN−**; **RF** from IN− back to OUT. The pins are as in 2.5; either half A or B works.
- Generator: sine, **`1 kHz`**, amplitude **`0.5 V`**. CH1 on the input, CH2 on OUT.
Compare the two waves: how do CH2's size and direction differ from CH1's?

cards.title: Virtual ground: IN− pinned at 0 V
text: - An op-amp with negative feedback moves its output until **IN− is as high as IN+**. IN+ is on ground, so IN− stays at 0 V too: a **virtual ground**.
- The input current i = v_in / RIN reaches IN− and has nowhere else to go (the op-amp's inputs draw no current), so **all of it passes through RF** to OUT.
![](fig:inv)
- One end of RF sits at 0 V, so the output is the voltage across RF, with the direction reversed:
$$v_o = -\frac{R_F}{R_{IN}} v_{in} = -\frac{22 kΩ}{10 kΩ} v_{in}$$
- The minus sign is the flip: when the input goes up, the output goes down.
![](fig:wave)

cards.title: Measure the gain, the flip and the clipping
text: - Try three inputs in turn: ① amplitude **`0.5 V`**; ② add a **`1 V`** offset; ③ amplitude **`5 V`**, offset **`0 V`**.
- In ② measure OUT to GND with the multimeter on DC: is the DC part enlarged and flipped too?
- In ③ the formula promises a big output, but the screen shows it **clipped flat**. Where are the top and bottom limits?
- Write your prediction in each question first, then read.

cards.title: Take away
text: - **Virtual ground**: with IN+ on ground, IN− is held at 0 V too. So this amplifier's input resistance is just RIN.
- **Gain = −RF / RIN**: the minus means inverted; DC is enlarged and flipped the same way.
- **The LM358's output can't reach the positive supply**: it tops out near V+ − 1.5 V but reaches V−, so the clipping is lopsided.
- **In a real circuit**: the LM358 slews only about 0.3–0.5 V/µs. At tens of kHz and large swings a sine turns into a triangle; the simulation has no such limit.

tests.name: 1 kHz、1 Vpp 正弦：输出被放大、平均 0 V
加 1 V 偏置：直流也被放大并反相，IN− 是虚地
输入 10 Vpp：输出上下削顶

compare:
**对比**：v_o = −(RF / RIN) × v_in = **−2.2 v_in**，输入电阻就是 RIN = 10 kΩ。
1. 输出 ≈ **2.19 Vpp**，平均 0 V，和输入反相（相差 180°）。不是 2.2 Vpp：信号发生器的 50 Ω 和 10 kΩ 分压，端口只有约 0.995 Vpp，按端口电压算增益正好 2.20；
2. 输出平均值 ≈ **−2.19 V**：直流也被放大并反相；IN− 一直在 0 V；
3. 按公式输出 22 Vpp，但最高只到 V+ − 1.5 = **+7.5 V**，最低到 V− = **−9 V**：削顶上下不对称。

measurements.ask: ① 幅度 0.5 V：CH2（输出）的峰峰值
measurements.explain: |v_o| = 2.2 × 1 Vpp ≈ 2.2 Vpp。信号发生器的 50 Ω 和 10 kΩ 输入电阻分压，端口只有约 0.995 Vpp，所以约 2.19 Vpp。

measurements.ask: 同一状态：输出幅度 / 输入幅度（CH2 / CH1，CH1 接在信号发生器的输出端）
measurements.explain: 按端口电压算 |v_o / v_in| = RF / RIN = 2.2。屏幕上两条波正好上下颠倒（相差 180°）。

measurements.ask: ② 加 1 V 偏置：万用表直流档测 OUT 对 GND
measurements.explain: 直流也被放大并反相：−2.2 × 0.995 ≈ −2.19 V。IN− 一直在 0 V（虚地）。

measurements.ask: ③ 幅度 5 V：输出的最大值
measurements.explain: 按公式应到 +11 V，但输出最高只有 V+ − 1.5 V ≈ +7.5 V。

measurements.ask: 同一状态：输出的最小值
measurements.explain: LM358 的输出能一直到负电源 V− = −9 V：上下削顶不对称。

hints: 双电源：两台 9 V 电源串联，中点是 GND。上面那台的 + 接运放 8 脚，下面那台的 − 接 4 脚。
IN+（3 脚）接 GND；信号发生器 + → RIN → IN−（2 脚）；RF 在 IN− 和 OUT（1 脚）之间。
放两个探头（CH1 输入、CH2 输出），接地夹都夹 GND。
